description: The developer’s team for an app (Negocio › Equipo in the panel): people who sign in to developers.neblla.com with their own email (any Neblla account, not only a developer's), and use this MCP with their own account. Each member is in one or more GROUPS of the team, and their rights ADD UP (a partner who also teaches is in «partner» and in a group of teachers); the server applies them on every route of the panel and every tool here, and a call no group of theirs allows answers not_allowed. A group says, per area of the panel (home, stats, people, business, moderation, team, testers, panels, features, money, build, publish, settings), "read" or "write" (nothing when absent); team and money can only be read: the owner alone changes the team and the money, and archives or deletes the app. `own: true` narrows Business to what is the member's own (the sessions they give and who is in them, their hours, their line of the accounts; they are the professional of neblla_business kind "staff" with the same email); `panels` gives custom screens by name. Ready-made groups (templates, and their ids work as groups as they are): "partner" (Socio: everything but money, the plan and deleting the app), "support" (Comunidad y soporte: the people of the app, the Business tab, and the sales, read only), "viewer" (Solo mirar: everything, read only), "screens" (Solo una pantalla: only the custom screens in `panels`) and "staff" (Profesional: Business, only what is theirs). action "add" { email | friend, groups?: [ids], access? (one ready-made group, as before groups), panels?: [names] | "*", role?, expiresInDays? } invites them (someone new without groups is in "screens"): an email goes out and they accept it signed in with that address, within expiresInDays (1-30, 7 by default); an address without a Neblla account yet is pre-registered: everything is set, the invitation does not expire and waits in their list the day they sign up (status not_registered until then). `friend`: the id of a Neblla friend of yours (action "friends"), invited without knowing their address, which stays hidden (key f:<id>) until they accept. On someone already there "add" changes groups, panels or role (a pending invitation is sent again with a new date). "resend" { email, expiresInDays? } sends a pending or expired invitation again. "remove" { email } takes them (or their invitation) out at once; not one they sent to «Baneadas» (status banned): only they take it back, and until then "add" answers invitation_banned. "list" → { team: [{ key, email, name, groups, access, panels, role, status: active | invited | not_registered | expired | banned, expiresAt?, invitedBy? }] }; "lookup" { email } → { registered, name } (the whole address only); "friends" → { friends: [{ id, name }] }. "groups" → { groups: [{ id, name, rights, own, panels, template, members }], templates }; "group_save" { id?, name, rights, own?, sites?, panels?, members?: [emails] } creates or changes one (members, when given, are exactly who is in it; sites: ids of the business's sites — neblla_business kind "sites" — its Business is limited to: its people see and change only the sessions, bookings, client cards, places, closures, chats and accounts of those sites, by every road; such a group gives no people nor moderation area, which mix every site; [] or null: the whole business); "group_delete" { id } (its people keep their other groups). role: one of the app's roles (neblla_update_app({ roles })) — the member then also sees every panel over what the role can read, and presses its buttons where it can write. Only the owner changes the team. Who opens the draft (pre) is neblla_pre_access. HANDING THE APP OVER to another developer (e.g. the same person with a second business and its own Neblla account): "add" { email, owner: true } invites them as OWNER (someone already on the team too); when they accept, signed in with that address and with a developer account, the app is theirs (files, users, data, team, in pro and pre), and the owner before stays in the team as "partner" until they leave it (or the new owner removes them). One owner offer at a time; "add" { email, owner: false } withdraws it; the member shows owner: true while it is open. An app that sells changes hands too: the owner invitation answers selling: [{ what: paid_products | live_subscriptions, count? }] (null when its purchases cannot be read). When they accept, its products wait hidden until the new owner's Stripe takes money and then publish by themselves, and its live subscriptions keep charging on the Stripe they were born on (the owner before's) until each customer cancels, while the new ones go to the new owner's; the acceptance answers stripe: { changed, productsWaiting, subscriptionsStay }. Neblla cancels nothing: an owner who prefers to cut cancels them by hand and tells their users. Pro is not the app's but its project's: it does not stop the handover and stays with the project.

access.description: One ready-made group, as before groups

expiresInDays.description: Days the invitation can be accepted in (7 by default)

friend.description: A Neblla friend's id (action "friends"), instead of email

groups.description: The groups they are in: ids of the app's groups or ready-made ones (partner, support, viewer, screens, staff)

members.description: group_save: exactly who is in it (emails or keys)

own.description: group_save: Business only what is the member's own

owner.description: add: true invites them to become the app's owner; false withdraws that offer

sites.description: group_save: the sites of the business its Business is limited to (C350); [] or null: all of it

name: neblla_team
